name: ai-sources
title: AI Sources
description: Three overlapping source icons and an overflow count sit under an AI answer. Clicking opens a list where each source's icon slides into its own row with a title and a short snippet.
use: An AI answer or research summary must show its citations inline without pushing the prose off screen.
avoid: Only three icons show when collapsed, and long titles and snippets truncate, so a wide citation panel may fit better.
a11y: Uses aria-expanded and real links, but the collapsed stack's letter tiles and +2 are read out before the label. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A small inline control: three overlapping circular favicon chips, a +2 count, the word Sources and a chevron. Expanded, it becomes a column of rows, each with a round icon, a bold title and a grey snippet line, on a dark card.
behaves: Hovering fans the stacked icons slightly apart; clicking expands the control into a list, the chevron turning to point down while each icon travels into its row and rows fade in one after another. A second click collapses it.
customise: Pass a sources array of id, title, url, snippet and an optional favicon node; label text and the default-open state are props. Row markup and timing need a source edit.
weight: light: A handful of spans and a height and opacity animation that runs only while opening.
demo: A passage on dark oxygen at the seafloor and five citations about manganese nodules.
polishWhy: Icon travel from stack to row is well staged; mid-open frames are briefly hard to read.
